scope: Native review of near indirect CALL sites admitted as opaque-indirect-call-v1: instruction identity only. Every target is explicitly unidentified and no calling convention, argument use or runtime ABI compatibility is claimed. Static bytes only; no original execution.

eng3.01050@table_0xdc.basis: Embedded jump table: every entry is a DIR32 to a local code label; the comparator checks each native entry against its own decoded instruction boundary and the original HIGHLOW inventory.
